depiction.primary_object: two curved arrows forming a counterclockwise circle
depiction.composition: centered exclamation point flanked by left and right curved sync arrows

readings.meaning: sync error, failed synchronization, or sync conflict
update required or pending software update alert
failed backup or broken recurring process

ambiguity: Can be read as either a failed sync/backup error or an urgent reminder that a software update or renewal is overdue.

modifier_semantics.meaning: error, warning, conflict, or urgent attention needed

task_intents: resolve a version or merge conflict
fix a broken recurring bank transfer
reconnect a disconnected calendar or account
renew an expiring subscription on time

reasoning: The two curved arrows forming a loop with an exclamation mark inside clearly signify a sync error, failed recurring process, or urgent software update. It fits technical, work, and financial tasks about fixing broken syncs, failed backups, or stalled auto-renewals, though it is narrower than general object icons.
